policy: Conservative financial-indicator and reporting-frequency evidence gates
purpose: Prevent semantically adjacent GDP/CPI passages from standing in for unsupported banking indicators
frequency: Annual/year-on-year and monthly/month-on-month require corresponding explicit source frequency words.
scope: Urban and rural labels are preserved. Real GDP growth is separated from GDP deflator and per-head measures.
limitations: These rules are heuristics. They can reject valid paraphrases and do not prove arbitrary question answerability. Independent human review remains necessary.
measure_identity: Contribution/share differs from sector growth; nominal GDP differs from per-head GDP; explicit quarters require the corresponding source period.
hybrid_evidence_gate: A strong lexical coverage match may supply evidence when cosine similarity is below the threshold; vector-only retains the semantic threshold.
